title: Schedule
subtitle: Manage appointment booking and time slots

emptyState.selectStaff: Select a professional and a date to view the schedule.
emptyState.noAppointments: No appointments for this professional on this date.
emptyState.noUnavailability: No blocked periods for this professional.

create.title: New Appointment
create.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Follow-up visit, blood test results
create.description: Pick the patient, the professional and the time. The summary updates as you go.
create.patientHint: Type part of the name to narrow the list.
create.patientNoMatch: No patient matches this search. Check the spelling or clear the search.
create.endTimeHintNoStart: Pick the start first; the end is filled in for you.

cancel.title: Cancel Appointment
cancel.description: Are you sure you want to cancel this appointment?
cancel.hint: The appointment is kept in the record and marked as cancelled.

edit.title: Edit Appointment
edit.description: Change the details and save. The summary shows the new booking.

errors.conflict: This professional already has an appointment or a blocked period in this interval. Choose another start time or another professional; your entries were kept.
errors.loadAppointmentsDescription: The appointments for the selected professionals could not be retrieved. Try again.
errors.submitFailed: Your entries were kept. Check your connection and try again.

validation.patientRequired: Select a patient. Use the search box to find them by name.
validation.staffRequired: Select the professional who will see the patient.
validation.reasonMax: The reason must be at most 500 characters.
validation.dateFuture: Past dates cannot be booked. Pick today or a later date.
validation.endAfterStart: End time must be after the start time ({{startTime}}).
validation.startTimeAligned: The appointment start time must be aligned to a valid slot time (:00, :15, :30 or :45).
validation.startTimePast: That start time has already passed. Pick a later time today or another date.
validation.slotDuration: Appointments last 30 or 45 minutes. For a start at {{startTime}}, choose {{suggestions}}.

modal.title: Block Unavailability Period
modal.description: Block a period so no appointments can be booked in it.
modal.descriptionForStaff: Block a period for {{staff}} so no appointments can be booked in it.
modal.endTimeHint: Filled in as 1 hour after the start; you can change it.

deleteModal.title: Remove Unavailability Period
deleteModal.description: Are you sure you want to remove this unavailability period?

errors.conflict: This professional already has an appointment or a blocked period in this interval. Adjust the start or end time; your entries were kept.
errors.submitFailed: Your entries were kept. Check your connection and try again.

summary.label: Booking summary
summary.empty: Choose a date and a start time to see the summary.
